question: For which recorded active-ingredient declarations does the same frozen tariff candidate have at least one compatible and at least one contradictory package-route path?
prior_knowledge: Overall route populations, six newly exposed SC-IV paths, stable path counts and ingredient-tariff materialization counts were already inspected. Declaration-by-tariff mixed-context groups have not been computed for this follow-up. This is local prospective specification within an explored dataset, not external preregistration.
population: Every inferred SL source-row ingredientTariffCandidate relationship in the frozen June graph; documentary Swiss paths only.
group_key: (recorded ingredient declaration, exact tariff source-record ID); declaration normalization only strip, casefold and collapse whitespace; no synonyms or ingredient splitting.
primary_outcome: All groups containing at least one VERIFIED and one CONTRADICTED path under exact_code; no minimum-count threshold.
secondary_outcomes: Complete group status profiles under each policy
Exact-code mixed groups also mixed under explicit_formulation
Mixed groups absent under coarse but present under exact_code
Complete product, package and premise traces for every selected group
interpretation: Same recorded ingredient description is a documentary grouping, not established molecular identity, therapeutic interchangeability or billing eligibility.
inference_use: Follow-up query consumes materialized ingredientTariffCandidate edges and source-bound package/tariff context.
comparators: No-materialization query on identical input triples
Independent SQL join from frozen SAI, SL and tariff source fields; separate lexical route decision expression
acceptance: Complete inferred ingredient/tariff pair agreement with source SQL
Every selected group has exact supporting positive and conflicting source paths
No-materialization and removed-chain query return no materialized input edges
Restored-chain sets and selected outcomes equal full inference
Preserve all documentaryTariff predicates when ingredient chain is removed
